subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan - KiteBank
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@kitebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan - KiteBank

Sam —

Thanks again for your time today. Great conversation — appreciate you walking us through KiteBank's current fraud-detection flow and the three callouts you mentioned (high false-positive rate on low-value transactions, latency spikes during peak hours, and the desire to reduce per-inference costs). Recap + next steps below.

Quick demo recap:
- We showed the Redwood end-to-end flow (model selection, quantized serving, and KV prefix caching) and ran the sample rule-based to ML handoff.
- Key falls: we saw 80-120ms median token latency on the sample policy, and batching reduced unit cost by ~30% in the demo environment.

Proposed POC objectives (success criteria) — 4 week engagement:
1) Latency: median inference latency <= 150ms for the 95th percentile request mix (as observed in your peak-hour traces).
2) Cost: reduce model inference unit cost by >= 20% vs current baseline through batching/quantization and caching strategies.
3) Accuracy/Quality: parity within 2% of your current production model on the labeled eval set (we'll use your holdout data and the red-team prompts you mentioned).
4) Reliability: demonstrate stable throughput for sustained 10 RPS load with graceful degradation policies in place.

Proposed evaluation plan and roles:
- Week 0 (kickoff): NDA + access, onboarding, dataset handoff, environment access (2 business days).
- Week 1: Baseline ingestion + run Redwood benchmark against a 24-hour sample workload (owner: KiteBank data/ML infra; Redwood SE: Dylan).
- Week 2: Integrate prefix caching + batching profile; run accuracy checks on holdout set (owner: Redwood Solutions — Marissa).
- Week 3: Tune quantization profile and run cost/latency sweep; produce final metrics report.
- Week 4: Review, remediation items, and decision meeting (success review).

Immediate asks from KiteBank:
- Access: sample 24-hour trace and holdout eval set (S3 link + schema).
- Contacts: primary POC (security/infra) + ML reviewer (for quality checks).
- NDA: we can send a standard POC NDA for signature prior to data transfer.

Attachments: kitebank-poc-outline.pdf (detailed timeline + MEP), redwood-poc-setup-checklist.xlsx (access checklist).

If this looks right I can: (1) send the NDA link, (2) schedule a 60-min kickoff next Tuesday (Nov 24) with your infra/security and ML folks, and (3) loop in Dylan and Marissa on the kickoff invite.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference for LLMs

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@kitebank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan - KiteBank

Camila —

Appreciate the recap and the clear success criteria. A few quick clarifying questions before we move to NDA and kickoff: 

1) Data & security: For the POC we'll need to know whether Redwood requires production data in our environment or if the POC can run in Redwood's hosted environment with an encrypted upload. Our security team generally prefers VPC/on-prem options for raw transaction traces.

2) Infra footprint: Do you have an estimate of GPU/CPU and storage requirements for the 10 RPS sustained test? Our infra team needs a ballpark to provision an isolated test cluster.

3) Stakeholders: I can be the executive sponsor. I'll loop in Anita Rao (Dir, ML) and our infra lead (I'll confirm name after I sync with them). Who should be our main Redwood contacts for technical onboarding and for the final success review?

Thanks — will review the attachments but the plan looks reasonable.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Fraud Engineering | KiteBank
sam.patel@kitebank.com | +1 212-555-0146

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo Recap + Proposed POC Plan - KiteBank

Sam — thanks for the quick questions. Answers below and next steps proposed.

1) Data & security:
- We can run the POC in three different modes depending on your security posture: (A) Hosted Redwood environment with encrypted S3 ingestion and strict IAM policies (fastest onboarding), (B) Private VPC peering where data never leaves your VPC (requires network setup), or (C) On-prem containerized deployment (longer lead time). For sensitive raw traces we typically recommend option B for enterprise teams.
- We'll provide a short checklist for required access and an encryption-by-default transfer flow. See attached redwood-poc-setup-checklist.xlsx for details.

2) Infra footprint (ballpark for 10 RPS sustained, 1k token average request):
- Recommended: 1 x A10G / 1 x 80GB GPU (or equivalent) for initial runs + 2x CPU workers for batching and pre/post processing. If you want to run a scaled stress test to 50 RPS we'll advise a 2nd GPU and horizontal scaling. Dylan (cc'd) will provide a more detailed sizing worksheet once we have the sample trace.

3) Redwood contacts / owners:
- Technical onboarding & infra: Dylan Brooks (dylan.brooks@redwood.com) — SE, responsible for setup and benchmark runs.
- Model evaluation & quality checks: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — Solutions Engineering.
- Executive/contract: Camila (me) for scope and success criteria.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today: I’ll send the NDA link for signature and attach the POC outline.
- Once NDA signed (Day 0): KiteBank provides S3 link with 24-hour trace + holdout eval set and list of POC participants.
- Day 1–5: Onboarding + baseline benchmark (Redwood + KiteBank infra).
- Week 2: Implementation of caching/batching + initial accuracy runs.
- Week 3: Tune quantization + cost/latency sweep.
- Week 4: Final review + success decision meeting.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Nov 24, 2026 @ 10:00 AM PT — 60 min (we’ll include Dylan, Marissa, your infra/security, and Anita if she’s available). Please confirm if that time works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

I’ve uploaded the POC NDA to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-poc-nda — I can re-run it to include KiteBank legal if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
